mechanism: Modafinil inhibits CYP2C9 and CYP3A4, reducing phenytoin metabolism and increasing phenytoin levels, while phenytoin induces CYP3A4, potentially reducing modafinil efficacy.
action: Monitor phenytoin levels closely; consider phenytoin dose reduction and increased monitoring for toxicity signs (ataxia, nystagmus, confusion); consider alternative wakefulness agent if possible.
